Usage: astryx integration verify [options]

Check the package the way npm will publish it, before you publish

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  the packed package exposes the same valid contributions
  1  the tarball is incomplete or invalid

Examples:
  # Check before publishing
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 integration verify
  # Machine-readable result
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 integration verify --json

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/integration-verify
